// diagnostic L0510

Jet.PreludeAliasShadow

Declaration `{name}` replaces the Core prelude alias `{name}`.

What

Declaration `{name}` replaces the Core prelude alias `{name}`.

Why

The readable Core prelude opens `{name}` in every file, and this declaration silently wins over it in its file, so a call that reads like the prelude's runs this one.

Fix

Rename `{name}` and its calls to a name the prelude does not open.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.PreludeAliasShadow: Tests/UI/prelude_alias_shadow_assert_eq.stderr.

Error: Jet.PreludeAliasShadow: Declaration `assert_eq` replaces the Core prelude alias `assert_eq`.
  --> Tests/UI/prelude_alias_shadow_assert_eq.jet:4:1
    |
  4 | assert_eq: fn(value: Int) -> Int Never! { value + 1 }
    | ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The readable Core prelude opens `assert_eq` in every file, and this declaration silently wins over it in its file, so a call that reads like the prelude's runs this one.
 Fix: Rename `assert_eq` and its calls to a name the prelude does not open.
